test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the environmental loss if many trees are cut in a forest to get wood?

options.text: It will give livelihood to many poor people.
It will let in more sunlight to let smaller plants to grow.
It will provide open space for other trees to grow.
It will lead to soil erosion and degradation.

solution:
The correct answer is__** It will lead to soil erosion and degradation.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cutting down many trees in a forest will lead to **soil erosion and degradation** as trees hold the soil together and prevent it from washing away during heavy rains or winds.
 
• Deforestation can also cause a **decrease in soil fertility** as the nutrients in the soil are absorbed by the remaining plants and are **not replenished** by the **decaying leaves** and branches of the cut down trees.
 
• Deforestation also leads to an **increase in greenhouse gas emissions** as trees absorb **carbon dioxide** and **release oxygen** during photosynthesis.
 
• Cutting down trees **reduces** the amount of carbon dioxide absorbed and** increases **the amount of carbon dioxide released into the atmosphere.
 
• While cutting down trees may provide** livelihood **to some people, it is not a sustainable solution in the long run as it leads to environmental degradation and loss of biodiversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​Environmental degradation** is the term used to describe how the environment **deteriorates** due to pollution, ecosystem devastation, species extinction, habitat destruction, and the loss of resources like clean air, water, and soil.
 
• It is described as any **alteration or disruption** to the surroundings that is thought to be harmful or unfavorable.
 
• **Pollution of the air, water, natural environment, garbage,** and so on are some of the main environmental issues that are causing a lot of concern.
 
• The **High-level Panel on Threats,** Challenges and Change of the** United Nations** has formally warned of **ten threats**, including environmental degradation.
